Practical rules for situations where appearance alone is not enough.
Do not taste food from a bulging, leaking, spurting, or badly damaged can. Discard it safely.
Cold-chain and storage history matter more than color alone. Slime, strong off-odor, package swelling, or unsafe storage are discard signals.
Visible mold can extend below the surface. For porous bread, discard the affected loaf instead of trimming only the visible spot.
Some hazards do not change smell or appearance. Prompt cooling, refrigeration, and known time-temperature history are essential.
Strong ammonia-like odor, heavy slime, mushy flesh, or an unsafe cold chain are warning signs. Do not rely on appearance alone.
